# Academy Award for Best Animated Feature Film award ## Winners and nominees [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ef/Hayao_Miyazaki.jpg/250px-Hayao_Miyazaki.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Hayao_Miyazaki.jpg) [Hayao Miyazaki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayao_Miyazaki) won twice for _[Spirited Away](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirited_Away)_ (2001) and _[The Boy and the Heron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Boy_and_the_Heron)_ (2023).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/52/Andrew_Stanton_cropped_2009.jpg/250px-Andrew_Stanton_cropped_2009.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Andrew_Stanton_cropped_2009.jpg) [Andrew Stanton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrew_Stanton) won twice for _[Finding Nemo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finding_Nemo)_ (2003) and _[WALL-E](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WALL-E)_ (2008).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3a/Brad_bird_cropped_2009.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Brad_bird_cropped_2009.jpg) [Brad Bird](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Bird) won twice for _[The Incredibles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Incredibles)_ (2004) and _[Ratatouille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ratatouille_(film))_ (2007).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/04/Nick_Park%2C_BBC_Radio_2_Folk_Awards_2007.jpg/250px-Nick_Park%2C_BBC_Radio_2_Folk_Awards_2007.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Nick_Park,_BBC_Radio_2_Folk_Awards_2007.jpg) [Nick Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nick_Park) won for _[Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wallace_&_Gromit:_The_Curse_of_the_Were-Rabbit)_ (2005).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/13/George_Miller_%2835706244922%29.jpg/250px-George_Miller_%2835706244922%29.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:George_Miller_(35706244922).jpg) [George Miller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Miller_(filmmaker)) won for _[Happy Feet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happy_Feet)_ (2006).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fd/Pete_Docter_cropped_2009.jpg/250px-Pete_Docter_cropped_2009.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Pete_Docter_cropped_2009.jpg) [Pete Docter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Docter)[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Animated_Feature#cite_note-13) won thrice for _[Up](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Up_(2009_film))_ (2009), _[Inside Out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out)_ (2015) and _[Soul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soul_(2020_film))_ (2020).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/05/Lee_Unkrich_cropped_2009.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lee_Unkrich_cropped_2009.jpg) [Lee Unkrich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lee_Unkrich) won twice for _[Toy Story 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toy_Story_3)_ (2010) and _[Coco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coco_(2017_film))_ (2017).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b8/Gore_Verbinski_1.JPG/250px-Gore_Verbinski_1.JPG)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Gore_Verbinski_1.JPG) [Gore Verbinski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gore_Verbinski) won in 2011 for _[Rango](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rango_(2011_film))_. [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a9/Annecy_Festival_2019%2C_screening_event_Toy_Story_4_-_Jonas_Rivera.jpg/250px-Annecy_Festival_2019%2C_screening_event_Toy_Story_4_-_Jonas_Rivera.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Annecy_Festival_2019,_screening_event_Toy_Story_4_-_Jonas_Rivera.jpg) [Jonas Rivera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonas_Rivera) won twice for _Inside Out_ (2015) and _[Toy Story 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toy_Story_4)_ (2019).[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/99/Byron_Howard.jpg/250px-Byron_Howard.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Byron_Howard.jpg) [Byron Howard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Byron_Howard) won twice for _[Zootopia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zootopia)_ (2016) and _[Encanto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Encanto)_ (2022). Film directors [Bob Persichetti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Persichetti), [Peter Ramsey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Ramsey), and [Rodney Rothman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rodney_Rothman), and producers [Phil Lord and Christopher Miller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phil_Lord_and_Christopher_Miller) won for _[Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:_Into_the_Spider-Verse)_ (2018). [Guillermo del Toro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guillermo_del_Toro) and [Mark Gustafson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Gustafson) won in 2022 for _[Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guillermo_del_Toro's_Pinocchio)_. [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/97/Toshio_Suzuki%2C_Howl%27s_Moving_Castle_premiere.jpg/250px-Toshio_Suzuki%2C_Howl%27s_Moving_Castle_premiere.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Toshio_Suzuki,_Howl's_Moving_Castle_premiere.jpg) [Toshio Suzuki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toshio_Suzuki) won in 2024 for _[The Boy and the Heron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Boy_and_the_Heron)_ as a film producer. [Gints Zilbalodis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gints_Zilbalodis) and [Matīss Kaža](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mat%C4%ABss_Ka%C5%BEa) won in 2025 for _[Flow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flow_(2024_film))_. At the same year, the Academy enacted a new rule regarding the [motion capture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motion_capture) technique employed in films such as _[A Christmas Carol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Christmas_Carol_(2009_film))_ (2009) and _[The Adventures of Tintin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Adventures_of_Tintin_(film))_ (2011), directed by [Academy Award for Best Director](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Director) winners [Robert Zemeckis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Zemeckis) and [Steven Spielberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Spielberg) respectively, and how they might not be eligible in this category in the future. ### 2020s | Year | Film | Nominees | |-|-|-| | [2020](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_in_animation)
